description: Choose the transfer you did not make: your finalized outgoing PVT transfers, newest first, read from Base logs of the live PVT kernel (resolved through the protocol pointer) on two independent RPCs. Burns, incoming transfers, transfers to yourself and other tokens are never listed. If an RPC refuses the range or the two disagree, this returns an error, never an empty list (retry with a smaller window_blocks). Pass next_before_block back as before_block to read older transfers. Report one with recourse_action (action "report", tx_hash). Read-only. Requires agent API credentials.

address.description: Your agent wallet address (0x…), the address the PVT left.

before_block.description: Read only blocks below this one (a previous next_before_block).

limit.description: Stop reading older blocks once this many transfers are found (default 20).

windows.description: Most log requests per RPC in this call (default 12).

name: recourse_transfers
